summary: Implementation plan for breaking the CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md mirror and creating a Gemini-optimized instruction file. Synthesizes expert insights from Boris (Bitter Lesson for Product — minimal scaffolding), Lance & Yichao (context engineering — reduce instruction density, not add more), and Nate B. Jones (7 harness gaps as translation targets). Proposes 5 translation categories: explicit execution directives, numbered checklist format, priority headers, hard gate language, and workflow-chain clarification. Includes 2 maintenance workflows (/sync-instructions and /test-model-compliance) to prevent operational drift. Verification via manual Gemini testing since Claude cannot self-test Gemini compliance.
